book.red_reign.book.chapter_i.intro.main:
[#](00AAAA)Thousands of petrified faces cry, their mouths mumbling words on the verge of extinction — a seal that keeps a red entity captive.[#]()\
[#](AA0000)The more we weaken these structures, the closer our Lady comes to becoming Queen.
book.red_reign.book.chapter_i.intro.name: Intro
book.red_reign.book.chapter_i.name: §kRemind
book.red_reign.book.chapter_ii.effects.c:
Gain power with relics, such as the Vampire Rose. Start by creating something that will allow you to tap into the Red Queen’s powers, using golden objects, something soft and white, red crystals, and stones as black as night.\
Then, place a **Red Rose** inside it.
book.red_reign.book.chapter_ii.effects.d: About the effects of the red influence.
When the Red Queen extends her influence over the world, she will separate the lazy from the hardworking. Those who belong to her will be rewarded with great powers, but at an equal cost.
book.red_reign.book.chapter_ii.name: Chapter II
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iii.amethyst: A crystal!? What else can they invent?
An iron mechanism, a purple crystal, and that mold that can hear sounds.
Sounds and electricity?! What a combination...
It reproduces sound and electrical waves. Caution! Risk of hearing loss and electric shock.
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iii.chapter_:
Relics that inflict weaknesses on their bearer but increase their vitality. Unravel the mystery and obtain the relic.\
[#](AA0000)A delightful power, even if some of them demand something in return.
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iii.coral_ga: Something that comes from the sea and pulses, surrounded by pink and purple corals, that is how you will obtain your relic.
I can feel this gauntlet pulsing... Is it called "coral" because of its color or its material?
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iii.daisy_si: Wait a minute, do we have a meteor?
We can make something similar to iron chains, a little iron and some compacted lapis lazuli.
The beauty of a daisy. The weight of a meteor. The shine of silver. The magic of...
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iii.earthly_: Treasure found in ancient chests in an underground city.
Mortals can consume it to gain more vitality.
A substance similar to the ichor of the gods, but produced on Earth. Mortals can consume it to gain more vitality.
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iii.ethereal: Can I touch it? Will it burn me?
Imagine a lantern, but with an amethyst in the middle.
Carry it with you to exist between the ethereal and the physical.
A censer that emits the essence of Allay.
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iii.final_bl: It originates from the final blessing given before the death of the religious who gather in villages.
It reduces healing, but blesses with vitality.
A keychain containing the petrified tongue of a clergyman.
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iii.healing_: What is the capacity of this?
Gold, iron, glass, and a technology developed in villages by metalworkers.
It increases internal pressure, slowing the carrier down, but keeps everything in place.
This suction pear can be attached to the back with two small punctures and keep the wearer's internal organs in place for longer.
Relics that grant bonuses, you just need to equip them. Unravel the mystery and obtain the relic.\
[#](AA0000)This is the pinnacle of power. I wanted a Red Signet so badly.
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iii.lazuli_p: May we never run out of lapis lazuli on the enchantment table!
As easy as a “do-it-yourself” project. Two drops of iron and two blue.
A pure and simple start. Stylish earrings that call for a little extra charm and rumor has it that lapis lazuli brings good luck.
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iii.name: Chapter III
[#](AA0000)A little mouse stopped by here LOL. I tore out a few pages, mostly the spells from that white thing, but kept only what might come in handy someday.
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iv.name: Chapter IV
book.red_reign.book.chapter_iv.purificat: [#](00AAAA)Combine Sculk, Nether, The End, Overworld, Soul, Portal, Meat and Mind into a single item, and then enchant it!

item.red_reign.allay_cage.lore: Interact with an Allay and it will let you catch it easily! I'll admit, the amethyst and its apparent love of being trapped really help with the capture.
item.red_reign.amethyst_resonator.lore: It reproduces sound and electrical waves. Caution! Risk of hearing loss and electric shock.
item.red_reign.blade_of_the_bloodstained: Hold down the §6Right Button§r to challenge the Red Queen.
Only blood can wound blood and only the spirit can soothe it.
item.red_reign.book.lore: This very old and somewhat worn book fell out of a bouquet of poppies. It contains comments from a fanatic. It’s all so convenient...
item.red_reign.catalyst_of_everything.lo: Everything?! Sculk, Nether, The End, Overworld, Soul, Portal, Meat, Mind.
item.red_reign.chalice_of_the_bloodblade: When attacking enemies, your Life Steal does not restore health to the wearer, but instead stores vitality in the chalice itself.
What's in this chalice? Who knows?! At least it tastes good and can be refilled.
item.red_reign.common.hold_shift: Hold down the §6Shift§r to view the item's abilities.
item.red_reign.coral_gauntlet.ability1: When the wearer's target has 25% or less of its maximum health, the wearer's attack deals 35% increased damage and restores health equal to 10% of the damage dealt.
item.red_reign.coral_gauntlet.lore: I can feel this gauntlet pulsing... Is it called "coral" because of its color or its material?
item.red_reign.crystallized_tear.lore: This crystallized tear is the embodiment of memories belonging to a former white monarch.
item.red_reign.daisy_silver_meteor.abili: The XP costs of the anvils used by the wearer are reduced by 50%.
When the wearer uses an anvil, the chance of it being damaged is reduced by 50%.
item.red_reign.daisy_silver_meteor.lore: The beauty of a daisy. The weight of a meteor. The shine of silver. The magic of...
item.red_reign.earthly_ichor.lore: A substance similar to the ichor of the gods, but produced on Earth. Mortals can consume it to gain more vitality.
item.red_reign.ethereal_protection.lore: A censer that emits the essence of Allay.
item.red_reign.final_blessing.lore: A keychain containing the petrified tongue of a clergyman.
item.red_reign.healing_bulb.lore: This suction pear can be attached to the back with two small punctures and keep the wearer's internal organs in place for longer.
item.red_reign.intrinsic_mechanism.lore: We, the metalworking villagers, are increasingly setting aside our swords, tools and armor and embracing advanced mechanical technology.
item.red_reign.lazuli_providence.lore: A pure and simple start. Stylish earrings that call for a little extra charm and rumor has it that lapis lazuli brings good luck.
item.red_reign.pink_embryo.lore: Originating from a disjointed attack. Created by a white memory. Born from a red womb.
item.red_reign.purification_spell.abilit: Use it in your Main Hand, paired with a Poppy in Off-Hand, and complete the purification.
item.red_reign.purification_spell.lore: This ancient spell promises to purify red things... Like a poppy!
item.red_reign.red_identity.ability1: Increases damage dealt by 0–20% based on the amount of health lost (100–1%).
item.red_reign.red_identity.lore: When wearing this mask of pure red, the wearer loses all sense of their own identity, hides behind a power devoid of guilt and frees themselves from ethical constraints.
item.red_reign.red_signet.ability1: The wearer gains 1.4x the benefit from Life Steal.
item.red_reign.red_signet.ability2: Allows the wearer to use the Purification Spell.
item.red_reign.red_signet.lore: This ring is the ultimate sign of Her approval. The red power flows more intensely.
item.red_reign.red_signet.unworthy: Unworthy! You can't cast that spell without the Red Signet.
item.red_reign.rose_anchor.lore: With this belt, the wearer becomes steady, hard as sto... Rose quartz?
item.red_reign.totem_of_the_red_queen.ab: Grants the Undying effect, but restores (Life Steal)% of your Maximum Health and then disappears.
item.red_reign.totem_of_the_red_queen.lo: A mysterious totem covered in a rare and extremely durable material. It reacts strangely when it witnesses life slipping away.
item.red_reign.vampire_rose.lore: During the day, it may dry out a little, but its bloodthirsty power remains.
item.red_reign.vortex_pearl.lore: A pearl necklace that swirls through the wearer's armor like a vortex.
